summary: If dim rows(D) = 0, the filling theorem with c = 1 and F = rows(D) (= ⊤) gives s with dim Column(D) ≤ (1/2 + b_D⁻²)·dim Column(D) (φ = 0/0 = 0), impossible since Column(D) ≠ 0 and b_D⁻² < 1/2.

steps.claim: Suppose dim rows(D) = 0 (e). Apply ramifiedColumns_fill_rows with c = 1 and F = ⊤: some s has dim B_s⁻¹(⊤) ≤ ((1 + φ)/2 + b_D⁻²)·dim Column(D) with φ = dim ⊤/dim rows(D).

B_s⁻¹(⊤) = Column(D) and φ = 0/0 = 0 (finrank_top, e); so dim Column(D) ≤ (1/2 + b_D⁻²)·dim Column(D) with dim Column(D) > 0 (Column(D) is nontrivial, through columnCoords); norm_num reduces this to 1/2 ≤ b_D⁻², which contradicts the size comparison b_D⁻² < 1/2 (lt_of_hasLogBound).
steps.lean:
erw [finrank_top, e]; norm_num [finrank_pos_iff.2 D.columnCoords.nontrivial,
  ← lt_tsub_iff_left]; use D.lt_of_hasLogBound
